records.name: Lightning Impact
records.effect: Channels all Ki into a powerful Ki wave; rapid input increases power and touching the user while charging can paralyze the attacker.

records.name: Final Galick Rush
records.effect: Cast-exclusive ultimate variant used by Super Saiyan Blue Evolved Vegeta.

records.name: Lovely Showtime
records.effect: The game's cast-exclusive Power-Up Ultimate variant.

records.name: Super Dragon Flight (Ultimate)
records.effect: Ultimate variant of Super Dragon Flight with a unique animation and follow-up after the uppercut portion connects.

notes: These identities were absent from docs/data/skills.json at audit time. The current Xenoverse 2 Ultimate Attack documentation explicitly places Final Galick Rush, Lovely Showtime, and Super Dragon Flight (Ultimate) in the cast-exclusive Strike/Power-Up groups and gives their 300 Ki costs; Lightning Impact is listed with its 300 Ki cost and Ultra Pack 2/PQ142 acquisition. CaC-unavailable status is explicit in the cast-exclusive section. Exact unlock methods remain null where the source does not provide one.
